questions.questionHtml:
By interchanging the given two signs which of the following equation will be not correct?

× and -
questions.solution:
By using the BODMAS rule:

Checking the options:

1. 15 + 5 ÷ 1 - 9 × 4 = 70

After interchanging the symbols × and -

⇒15 + 5 ÷ 1 × 9 - 4 = 70

⇒15 + 5 × 9 - 4 = 70

⇒15 + 45 - 4 = 70

⇒60 - 4 = 70

⇒56 ≠ 70

2. 5 - 6 × 3 + 16 ÷ 4 = 31

After interchanging the symbols × and -

⇒5 × 6 - 3 + 16 ÷ 4 = 31

⇒5 × 6 - 3 + 4 = 31

⇒30 - 3 + 4 = 31

⇒27 + 4 = 31

⇒31 = 31

3. 11 + 6 × 3 - 8 ÷ 2 = 5

After interchanging the symbols × and -

⇒11 + 6 - 3 × 8 ÷ 2 = 5

⇒11 + 6 - 3 × 4 = 5

⇒11 + 6 - 12 = 5

⇒17 - 12 = 5

⇒5 = 5

4. 15 - 4 × 3 + 6 ÷ 1 = 63

After interchanging the symbols × and -

⇒15 × 4 - 3 + 6 ÷ 1 = 63

⇒15 × 4 - 3 + 6 = 63

⇒60 - 3 + 6 = 63

⇒57 + 6 = 63

⇒63 = 63

Only option 1 is not followed.

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

questions.questionHtml:
The question below consists of a set of labeled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph.

P. There once was a little boy who had a very bad temper.

Q. The boy gradually began to control his temper over the next few weeks, and the number of nails he was hammering into the fence slowly decreased.

R. His father decided to hand him a bag of nails and said that every time the boy lost his temper, he had to hammer a nail into the fence.

S. On the first day, the boy hammered 37 nails into that fence.
questions.solution: Answer to the given question is "PRSQ". The correct logical order  is as follows:There once was a little boy who had a very bad temper. His father decided to hand him a bag of nails and said that every time the boy lost his temper, he had to hammer a nail into the fence. On the first day, the boy hammered 37 nails into that fence. The boy gradually began to control his temper over the next few weeks, and the number of nails he was hammering into the fence slowly decreased.

Key Points

  • The most appropriate antonym of the word established from the given sentence is 'displaced.' (किसी का स्‍थान ले लेना या छीन लेना)
  • Established - having existed or done something for a long time and therefore recognized and generally accepted; achieve permanent acceptance or recognition for (स्थित, स्थापित.)
    • Example: The principle of the supremacy of national parliaments needs to be firmly established.
  • Displaced: having been forced out of its usual or original position.
    • Example: The displaced water spilt down the hill and flooded the highway.
  • Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.
